question_text: Mention any two occupational respiratory disorders and their causes in humans.

insider_note: Each disorder must be paired with the dust that causes it. A bare name earns nothing.

steps.label: Asbestosis
steps.why: Dust breathed in day after day settles in the lung and cannot be cleared, so the disease follows the job.
common_mistakes: Naming the disease without the dust that causes it.
Naming an infection such as pneumonia. These are dust diseases.
steps.memory_tip: Name the dust and the disease follows: asbestos, asbestosis.
steps.margin_note: One line for each disorder, with its cause.
lines: In certain industries harmful particles are
spread in the air. Long exposure causes

steps.label: Black lung disease
steps.why: Coal dust stains the lung tissue dark, which is where the common name comes from.
common_mistakes: Writing silicosis for coal miners. Silicosis belongs to quarry workers.
Giving only one disorder when two are asked.
steps.memory_tip: Coal dust blackens the lung — black lung disease.
steps.margin_note: Two named disorders with causes complete the answer.
lines: Black lung disease — found in coal mine

lines.text: Silicosis and siderosis are two more of them
